task.name: put_two_objects_into_plate_and_box
task.description: Use the right arm to put the doll on the blue plate and the left arm to put the stapler on the box.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the doll.
2. Grasp the doll with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the blue plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the doll on the blue plate.
5. Move the left arm to approach and align with the stapler.
6. Grasp the stapler with the left arm.
7. Move the left arm to align with the box.
8. Release the gripper to place the stapler on the box.
